cohort: The study included 70 women with eclampsia and imminent eclampsia, allocated to either a low-dose Solapur magnesium sulphate regimen or a standard Pritchard regimen.
finding: Both the low-dose Solapur and standard Pritchard regimens achieved comparable seizure control and perinatal outcomes, but the Solapur regimen was associated with significantly fewer toxicity events and lower serum magnesium levels.
